assertions.assertion: Creates a class that extends DynamicClientRegistrationValidator
Overrides ValidateGrantTypesAsync to reject grant types other than authorization_code
assertions.rationale: Overrides ValidateGrantTypesAsync returning an error unless the only grant type is authorization_code.

assertions.assertion: Overrides ValidateRedirectUrisAsync to enforce HTTPS on all redirect URIs
Sets RequirePkce = true in SetClientDefaultsAsync or equivalent override
Registers the validator using AddDynamicClientRegistrationValidator<T>() on the configuration builder
assertions.rationale: Registers via AddTransient<IDynamicClientRegistrationValidator, StrictDcrValidator>(), not AddDynamicClientRegistrationValidator<T>() on the configuration builder.
